label: GO after no reward: D1-fixation-error penalty, or switching a2->a1 after an unrewarded a2 trial
explanation: Fires only at GO and only when the previous outcome was not a reward (prev_reward == 0 covers 100% of activations, but at 7.7% precision). Two sources carry most of the mass: (1) the GO step right after a D1 fixation error, where the reward input is the -1 penalty (fires on 94% of these, precision 1.0, 44% of activation mass, the largest activations); (2) GO after an unrewarded a2 trial when the agent is about to switch to a1 (model_act == 1; precision ~0.59). The disjunction gives dev precision 0.61, recall 0.41, mass recall 0.73. Missed activations are many small ones scattered over unrewarded GO steps, often after a2 or during early episode trials (rate is highest for ep_trial 1-9 and falls steadily through the episode). Never fires at D1 or D2, or after a rewarded trial. Uses only observed inputs plus the agent own current policy argmax, so no future variables.
